detail.title: Consolidating Metareasoning and Epistemological Frameworks
detail.summary: This cycle integrates physical system robustness models into the existing framework of metareasoning-partitioning. The notebook revision incorporates quantum error correction research as a conceptual lens for self-correcting epistemological systems, while maintaining the focus on resource allocation in rational agents.
